description: salt-mountain baseline, copied by ops/bootstrap.sh and owned by this repo from then on.
Renovate only tracks version strings Dependabot can't see (custom regex managers below).
Dependabot owns package and GitHub Actions updates, and CVE fixes.
Add repo-specific customManagers / packageRules after the baseline ones.

customManagers.description: Bun: package.json packageManager (the repo's source of truth)
Bun: oven/bun image tags in Dockerfiles

packageRules.description: Bake time: hold new releases before proposing them (supply-chain age gate).
One PR per Bun release, moving every pin together (verify fails if they disagree).
Bun patches auto-merge on green. Minors wait for a human: check dependabot-core's bun/Dockerfile BUN_VERSION first, since Dependabot writes lockfiles with that Bun.
